locator.section: A. Allgemeiner Teil,I. Zielsetzung und Notwendigkeit der Regelungen

correction: The 10 TWh campaign target concerns heat-network feed-in. Failure to generate that amount of electricity from deep geothermal power plants does not establish failure of that heat target or a need to switch it to shallow heat pumps.
effect: If the passage treats the target as electrical output, it weakens the 250-power-plant feasibility objection; the passage may instead be a hypothetical comparison of options.
limits: The author elsewhere acknowledges direct heat from deep geothermal energy. Read as a hypothetical electricity scenario, the calculation need not misstate the target. The subsequent attributed therefore-link creates concern but is interpretive. Actual costs, geological availability and feasibility remain unproved. No intent is inferred.
materiality_explanation: Potentially major because it concerns the energy category used in a prominent feasibility/cost objection; no proven policy-relevant misdescription is asserted pending review.
direction_explanation: Null while unresolved; an established electrical-target misdescription would favour rejection.
